label: CCR gateway (GLM + GPT merged into one /model list)
note: claude-code-router v3 aggregates every configured provider behind one gateway, and CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_GATEWAY_MODEL_DISCOVERY makes Claude Code list them all under /model as 'provider/model'. CCR v3 stores its config in ~/.claude-code-router/config.sqlite, so providers and the client key MUST be created once by hand in the web UI (ccr ui, http://127.0.0.1:3458) — an installer cannot write them. TWO THINGS BITE HERE. (1) KEY: use the key named 'Local Gateway' (sk-ccr-...), NOT a 'Profile: <agent>' key. Profile keys are scoped to CCR's own launch path and return 401 on GET /v1/models — which is exactly the request gateway model discovery makes at startup, and a 401 there leaves Claude Code with no model metadata at all. (2) CONTEXT: CCR reports every model with context_length: null, so discovery never supplies a context window and Claude Code falls back to a small default — with a large startup context that is an immediate 'Context limit reached'. CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS below is therefore mandatory, not a tuning knob. It is one client-wide value, not per-slot, and it is set to 1000000 to match glm-5.2. CAVEAT: this is one client-wide ceiling, not per-model — whichever model a session is routed to must actually accept that much. gpt-5.6 exposes a ~1.05M API context window (comparable to glm-5.2's 1M), so 1000000 fits both; the 272K figure sometimes cited for gpt-5.6 is a pricing-tier threshold (input > 272K is billed at 2x input / 1.5x output), NOT a context cap. Smaller models still bite: glm-4.7 / glm-5-turbo (~200K) are far below 1M, so a session routed to those will grow the context past what the server accepts and fail mid-run — auto-compact will not rescue you. Lower this to 200000 if you route to those smaller models often. Model slots are deliberately left unset: CCR ids embed your own provider display name (e.g. 'Zhipu AI (China) - Coding Plan/glm-5.2'), so they cannot be shipped in a template — install.sh fills them by querying the live gateway, and until they are set the launcher passes no --model and you pick per session with /model.

service.label: claude-code-router
service.loginHint: ccr ui    # admin UI on :3458 — add providers, then copy the 'Local Gateway' key (sk-ccr-...), NOT a 'Profile: ...' key. Do NOT bind Claude Code as a client in CCR (Agent Profiles) — it overwrites the same settings our cl_ccr launcher manages and breaks this config; always launch via cl_ccr.
